Job Description
 Join an international organization from the retail sector, operating a modern warehouse infrastructure supporting large-scale distribution operations.
The company focuses on maintaining high operational standards, ensuring business continuity, and minimizing downtime in a dynamic logistics environment.
In this role, you will act as a hands-on IT Support Specialist responsible for maintaining and supporting on-site IT infrastructure, warehouse systems, and end-user environments.
You will work closely with international 2nd and 3rd line support teams, ensuring smooth operations of critical systems. This position requires a practical professional who is comfortable working on-site with hardware, network, and warehouse systems in a fast-paced logistics environment.
Start | ASAP (May 2026)
Working hours | 3-shift system (06:00–14:00 / 14:00–22:00 / 22:00–06:00), 6 days per week
Employment type | B2B Contract (1 FTE)
 Your Responsibilities
 Managing and maintaining warehouse IT ecosystem, including RF scanners (Point Mobile), PDA devices, and industrial printers (Zebra)
 Configuring, issuing, and supporting devices using MDM systems (SOTI, PMDM)
 Performing first-line support for warehouse and transport systems (WMS, TMS), including issue verification and escalation
 Diagnosing and resolving hardware, network, and infrastructure issues in on-site environments
 Supporting LAN infrastructure (Cisco), including physical troubleshooting and cooperation with 2nd line support
 Maintaining and troubleshooting security systems such as CCTV (Hikvision) and access control systems
 Supporting business users, including Active Directory account management, password resets, and workstation preparation
 Managing IT asset lifecycle using asset management tools (Snipe-IT)
 Monitoring and supporting environmental systems (temperature and humidity sensors)
 Documenting all activities and incidents in Jira in line with internal standards
 Maintaining up-to-date network and infrastructure documentation, including changes in cabling and VLANs
 Our Requirements
 Fluent Romanian (mandatory for on-site work)
 Communicative English (B1/B2) for cooperation with international teams
 Hands-on experience in IT support in on-site environments (hardware, network, infrastructure)
 Experience with LAN networks (preferably Cisco) and basic troubleshooting
 Experience with end-user support and Active Directory
 Ability to work with warehouse devices such as scanners, printers, and mobile terminals
 Experience with ticketing systems (e.g. Jira) and documentation practices
 Understanding of logistics or warehouse environments will be a strong advantage
 Ability to work in a shift-based system (3 shifts, 6 days per week)
 High level of ownership, independence, and attention to detail
